description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Slovenia working-day offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when slovenia 2026 statutory work-free dates over an explicitly selected Monday-Friday planning baseline. Seven named state holidays are not work-free; no extra Monday or bridge day is invented. Individual shifts, replacement weekly rest, employer/local/sector/school/bank schedules, religious leave, payroll, legal deadlines and future years are not computed.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts Slovenia authority-scope working days in exact coverage. Requires explicit mon_fri_planning; seven named state holidays do not add rest.
Example user requests: Add or subtract Slovenia working days around Easter Monday is statutory rest. | Add or subtract Slovenia working days around Whit Monday is not Whit Sunday. | Add or subtract Slovenia working days around Science Day is a state holiday without rest.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","working_days":0,"work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_state_holiday, is_statutory_non_working_day, is_non_rest_state_holiday, personal_roster_scope, payroll_scope.
Formula: planning_workday = weekday AND no statutory_work_free_event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/slovenia-public-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/slovenia-public-add-working-days.md

work_schedule.description: Required explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline; not an individual legal roster.

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_si_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Slovenia 2026 statutory work-free facts with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline

day_type.description: state_holiday_rest, other_statutory_rest, weekend_baseline or regular_workday; non-rest state holidays do not add rest.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_non_rest_state_holiday.description: Whether result.date is one of the seven state holidays that do not add rest.

is_state_holiday.description: Whether result.date is an article 1 state holiday, whether or not work-free.

is_statutory_non_working_day.description: Whether result.date is a statutory work-free holiday under article 1 or 2, excluding ordinary weekends.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Slovenia Working Days
